posts.author: cloudlandsdev
posts.description: Last week, I saw an article on the front page of the New York Times website reporting that a critical vulnerability in PHP had been found. posts.title: Full Op_return Pruning in Bitcoin
posts.author: epochbtc
posts.description: satd is the first Bitcoin node implementation to allow optional full OP_RETURN value pruning. It is controlled by these options:   -pruneopreturn=N (N is the number of blocks behind tip, 288 minimum to match NODE_NETWORK_LIMITED guarantee) -pruneopreturnsize=X (X is the value size in bytes, greater than or equal to X will be pruned) -restoreopreturns (stop pruning and restore all pruned blocks; mutually-exclusive with above options)  Why do OP_RETURN value pruning? The recent BIP-110 controversy...
